_comment: Builds against 3D-Mem's own HM3D copy (cfg/eval_refonbench.yaml: scene_data_path). Paths are relative to the 3D-Mem repo root, so run the CLI from there.
_comment_min_iou: min_iou is a frame-coverage fraction (object pixels / 512x512 frame), not an IoU. Measured on the example scene: 0.001 keeps 32% of whitelist objects as usable goals, 0.005 keeps 20%, 0.05 only 8%. Raising it starves the goal pool.
